concepts.def: Device converting physical quantity to electrical signal; temperature, light, pressure, infrared, motion.
Outputs causing physical action: motors, valves, LEDs; receives control signals from processor.
Sensor output influences control action; negative feedback stabilises (thermostat); positive amplifies.
Proportional-integral-derivative algorithm tuning actuator output; Ziegler-Nichols 1942 tuning method.
Computer dedicated to specific function within device; real-time constraints; microcontrollers like Arduino.
Branch of CS controlling autonomous physical systems; Three Laws of Robotics (Asimov 1942 short story).
